mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_SPEAR + i from Spear{i+1}; _enum.h names MODEL_BILL_OF_BALROG = MODEL_SPEAR + 9, and mu.db agrees: group 3 index 9, Item/Spear10.bmd.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Bill of Balrog, and the shelf dropped the line for want of a cooked mesh.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Scythe, TwoHanded: true.
sheet_from: Data/Item/af.OZT (64x128), from MuMain at c0d74c4. The .bmd names af.tga on all 138 triangles; its alpha cuts 7% away.
sheet_note: af is the Balrog's bill: a silver-white blade veined in magenta, a dark red haft band and black spikes.
cutout_from: Declared, not detected. af.tga's alpha cuts 7% away, and what it cuts is the veins drawn through the blade and a thin line down the haft - MU alpha-tests a .tga, so the Balrog's bill is cracked through.
material_note: Six islands on af, sampled per triangle. Island 0 (50) is the bill's blade, silver-white washed red at (138, 99, 96): steel at 0.45. Island 1 (32) is the haft, dark red-brown (93, 35, 11), 2 and 3 (16 each) the black spikes (90, 21, 0), 4 and 5 (12 each) the butt: plate_steel at 0.5 as the Gorgon Staff's pole, with desaturation 1.0 so the red haft does not go grey. MU scrolls this model's BlendMeshTexCoordV (ZzzObject.cpp:5267) but sets no BlendMesh, so nothing is drawn added and the scroll moves nothing; no glow.
